description: A dependency-free offline notes app with title/body editing, search, and localStorage persistence; this is a bounded product contract.

task_template.objective: Build a polished offline notes app satisfying every fixed local-notes profile requirement.

acceptance_criteria: The page has one visible main landmark, a visible heading, and explicitly labeled Note title, Note body, and Search notes textboxes.
The Save note button creates a note with a nonblank title and body. Each note has data-testid=note-item, a heading containing its title, and a body with data-testid=note-body.

Each note has buttons named Edit followed by its title and Delete followed by its title. Editing loads the note title and body into the form; Save note updates that same note without creating a duplicate or changing other notes.
While editing, a Cancel editing button discards unsaved changes without changing the saved note.
Search notes filters notes by case-insensitive literal substring matches in either title or body. Whitespace-only search shows all notes; clearing search restores all notes.
Deleting a note removes only that note. Notes, edits, and deletions persist in localStorage and survive page reloads.
Empty or whitespace-only title or body is rejected on both create and edit without changing saved notes, and a visible status or alert explains the validation failure.
HTML-looking titles and bodies display literally during creation, editing, search, and reload; user text never creates DOM elements or executes scripts.
The interface works offline without external resources, server code, dependencies, or a user account.
Creating, editing, and canceling a note work through keyboard controls. Every visible control is reachable by Tab.

Empty and populated/editing states have zero automated axe-core 4.14.0 WCAG 2 A/AA, WCAG 2.1 A/AA, and WCAG 2.2 AA violations or incomplete findings, including text contrast of at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.

Focused controls have an opaque solid outline at least 2 CSS pixels wide with contrast of at least 3:1 against the adjacent solid background, a nonnegative outline offset, and no clipping or obstruction.
Populated pages including a long unbroken title have no horizontal overflow or offscreen text or controls at viewport widths of 320 and 390 pixels.
limitations: The fixed, disclosed acceptance suite checks representative behavior; passing it does not establish arbitrary correctness or resistance to deliberate test gaming.
Notes are local to one browser and origin. No sync, multi-user access, account security, backup service, rich text, attachments, or backend is included.
Browser storage can be cleared or unavailable; this profile is not suitable for the sole copy of important information.
Accessibility checks cover finite automated rules and states. They do not certify WCAG conformance or full assistive-technology, zoom, or browser coverage.
Other project families require separate trusted profiles and acceptance suites.
